changes.title: Steady tempo
items: The night's tempo stays the same from wave to wave: your record's BPM (120 with none), so the spark keeps one speed all night
Only being knocked down speeds the beat up now; the music's style still changes every wave
Music Lab: the tempo ramp knob is gone, and the style shows one BPM for every wave

changes.title: Chain rework
items: Every animal on your leash is on an 80 m chain. Pull it taut and you drag it: youths slow you a little, adults a lot, and a legend stops you
Only adults and legends stop you taking off now; youths never do. Try anyway and their chains rattle
Your followers no longer weigh you down: no more slower rising or being pulled out of the sky
Chains lie on the ground at full length, invisible close by and glowing as they pull taut

changes.title: Buffs 20
items: Darters make you 20% faster and Stalkers make your 💌s fly 20% faster and further, for each kind leashed

changes.title: Party start fx
items: Starting the party is a proper spectacle now: a tall column of light shoots up above the treetops, a glowing dome blooms round the decks, bigger and brighter amber and rose sparkles fly out, and it all shows over the treehouse instead of hiding under it.
Once the party's going, press E (square on a controller) at your decks to play the party-start show again. The DJ shouts "make some noise!!!"
Every piece of the party-start show has its own sliders and switches in the pause page, under Party start.

changes.title: Follower buffs
items: Adults on your leash now give you a buff by how their kind retreats: extra dashes, faster movement, further-flying invites, shots both ways, faster firing or chaining invites
Different kinds stack; two of the same kind count once. A legend on your leash counts as three
An adult's buff runs on berries: up to five pips, two minutes each, shown beside its sigil. Lead it past berries to keep it going
Each buff shows an icon beside its animal's sigil, and the chain to a buffing animal glows
